```yaml
name: Claude CI Workflow

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  claude:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --workspace --all-features

      - name: Run Claude Code Base Action
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: |
            You are a helpful assistant. The repository is a Rust project. The CI has just run the tests. 
            • If any tests failed, diagnose the failures and provide a step‑by‑step plan to fix them. 
            • If all tests passed, provide suggestions for improving code quality, documentation, or tests. 
            • Emphasize an iterative approach: run tests locally, push changes, monitor CI, fix, repeat. 
            • Encourage the developer to push to a pull request after local tests pass. 
            • Ensure you do not return prematurely before all issues are resolved. 
            • Provide clear commit message suggestions and a list of changes to make. 
            • If you need more context, ask for it. 
          max_turns: 5
          model: claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620
          fallback_model: claude-3-haiku-20240307
          claude_env: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
```
